LESSON: TIME RELATED GREETINGS AND FAREWELL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Time related greetings and farewell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time related greetings and farewell, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we bid people farewell at different times? 2. Which words tell you that one is leaving to elsewhere?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time related greetings and farewell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Speaking as the learner role-plays greeting and responding to time related greetings

and farewell.

• Creativity and Imagination: Fluency as the learner tells words used to bid someone farewell.

Values:
• Unity: is enhanced as learners role-plays time related greetings and bidding each other farewell.

• Love: is enhanced as the learners greet each other in role-playing time related greetings and bidding of farewell.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner practises time related greetings and farewell while interacting with other people.

Link to other Learning Areas: Mathematics as the learner role plays greeting used at different times of the day.

Suggested learning resources: Recorded audio, charts, pictures showing ways of greeting and bidding farewell.
